question: Was my claim from last Tuesday paid?
answer: I can't check whether your claim from last Tuesday was paid. I can only see your plan documents. They explain what your plan covers, but they don't show individual claims or payments. I'm passing your question to a member services team member who can look up the claim. They can tell you its status, how much was paid and anything you might owe. To help them find it faster, have the provider's name and the date of service ready.
